nodes.label: Card edits become ONE undo step on close
nodes.norm_label: card edits become one undo step on close
nodes.rationale: Changes apply to the model immediately (touchCard) but are grouped into a single undo entry when the card closes (closeCard).

nodes.label: Derived done state from leaves
nodes.rationale: In nodes with children done is derived from the leaves (stats in index()); a parent checkbox sets every leaf below it.

nodes.label: Every model change goes through commit()/mutate(), then render() and scheduleSave()
nodes.norm_label: every model change goes through commit()/mutate(), then render() and schedulesave()
nodes.rationale: Ensures all changes (including collapse/expand) are undoable and persisted; render() reuses DOM by id and animates with requestAnimationFrame.

nodes.norm_label: create your own oauth client (5 setup steps)

nodes.norm_label: works offline and sends nothing over the network

nodes.label: Automatic backups never open a Google window
nodes.norm_label: automatic backups never open a google window
nodes.rationale: Browsers need a user gesture to open the sign-in popup, so an expired token is renewed on the next pointerdown (driveBackup gesture).

nodes.label: npm start serves localhost:5173 because Google sign-in fails on file://
nodes.norm_label: npm start serves localhost:5173 because google sign-in fails on file://
nodes.rationale: Google sign-in does not work from file://, so tools/serve.js serves index.html over http://localhost:5173.

nodes.label: Offline and local-first storage
nodes.rationale: No network calls except the optional Google Drive backup; data lives in localStorage (key trees:v1, legacy alberi:v1 migrated).

nodes.label: Search over title, tags and checklist items
nodes.norm_label: search over title, tags and checklist items

nodes.label: Node text written with textContent, never innerHTML
nodes.norm_label: node text written with textcontent, never innerhtml
nodes.rationale: Safety: user text is never interpreted as HTML.

nodes.label: tests/drive.js Drive backup suite (Playwright routes as fake Google)
nodes.norm_label: tests/drive.js drive backup suite (playwright routes as fake google)

nodes.label: Single index.html file, no build, no framework, no CDN
nodes.norm_label: single index.html file, no build, no framework, no cdn
nodes.rationale: A single HTML+CSS+JS file opens with a double click in any browser; no build step or external dependency.

nodes.label: External data goes through clean() / normalize()
nodes.norm_label: external data goes through clean() / normalize()
nodes.rationale: Imported or restored data is made safe and consistent before entering the model.
